build_coefficient_mapping: build a CoefficientMapping module to map spherical harmonic degree l and order m coefficients for a given lmax and mmax
create_coefficient_idx_lookup: create a coefficient index lookup for a specific degree l and order m using the CoefficientMapping coefficient_idx method
build_so3_grid: build an SO3_Grid module to transform irreps representations to and from a 2D spherical grid using e3nn
create_to_grid_transform: create a grid representation from an irreps embedding tensor using the SO3_Grid to_grid method with specified lmax and mmax
create_from_grid_transform: create an irreps representation from a spherical grid tensor using the SO3_Grid from_grid method with specified lmax and mmax
